result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 0 FOUND, 5 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Reviewed scoped source/configuration indicators for passwords, credentials, API keys, machine keys, cryptography, ACL APIs, authentication/authorization configuration, and logging. Indicator output suppressed credential values.

Checked-in connection configurations did not contain password assignments; the legacy application uses integrated security. No hard-coded cryptographic key or explicit unsafe critical-resource ACL assignment was established.

Catalog MVC actions log operations. Missing audit detail alone was not classified as an exploitable security vulnerability. The configured legacy log4net layout is PatternLayout, not the XML layouts implicated by CVE-2026-40021.

No secret validity checks, deployed identity/ACL inspection, external secret-store inspection, or exhaustive high-entropy secret detection. Source review cannot establish deployed permissions. Generic missing authentication is not relabeled as an explicit permission-assignment defect under CWE-732.
Execution duration was not measured. Timestamp records overall assessment completion.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging
values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
